PluginData.Author: Zeo-Corps
PluginData.Tooltip: 1.0 — Tactical HUD, ship status and shared fleet contacts.
PluginData.Description: Zeo Core 1.0 brings tactical ship markers, the TOS scope, ship and ammunition status, a friendly fleet roster, Battle Manager contact sharing, and a configurable HUD with draggable panels. Includes the native Zeo settings menu and matching external overlay. Windows / Pulsar Legacy. Sharing requires compatible server telemetry and Battle Manager settings.
